wire.t: The 49ers plan to play Mike Evans (Achilles tendinitis) Sunday night against Minnesota and waived Brandin Cooks on Saturday. Evans is officially Questionable and starts for Jefferson’s Reserve.

Baker Mayfield is expected to play Sunday at 1:00 against Detroit with a plantar fascia strain in his foot, wearing a custom orthotic and new cleats. He's starting at superflex for Catfan94’s Farm Team.

Drake Maye reportedly has a fractured right fibula that won't need surgery, with a small chance he returns late in the regular season. He's still in the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte quarterback slot as of Sunday morning.

At 6:03 AM ET Sunday, ManicOrientals added Bills tight end Dawson Knox and dropped Tyler Goodson. Knox is Buffalo's No. 2 tight end behind Dalton Kincaid, who is Doubtful and still in the OBJAY lineup. Daniel Jones, released by the Colts Friday, is still on the Asian Jim roster.

Final designations: Dalton Kincaid (thumb, ankle) is Doubtful. Brock Bowers (ankle, quad) and Ladd McConkey (back) are Questionable and both start in the late afternoon window, for LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Asian Jim. Darren Waller (knee) is Questionable on the Hold My DK bench.

Ruled Out for Week 11: Kenneth Walker III (benched by Catfan94’s Farm Team), Kyler Murray (Asian Jim bench), Jake Ferguson (Kraft for Cash IR), Marvin Harrison Jr. (Jefferson’s Reserve bench), Jordan Addison and Woody Marks (OBJAY bench).

Sunday slate for this league: seven 1:00 games, Jets-Chargers at 4:05, Jaguars-Giants and Raiders-Broncos at 4:25, Vikings-49ers Sunday night, and Bengals-Commanders on Monday night, where Joe Burrow, Tee Higgins and Ja'Marr Chase all play.

Justin Fields, the healthiest quarterback on the StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte bench, is Kansas City's No. 2 behind Patrick Mahomes. Jalon Daniels is Tampa Bay's No. 4 with Mayfield expected to play. Shedeur Sanders is on taxi and Jalen Hurts is on IR.

stories.title: Sunday of Week 11: three lineups with a hole in them, and the worst one is mine
stories.dek: Mike Evans is playing, Baker Mayfield is playing, Dalton Kincaid probably isn't, and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has no NFL starting quarterback on the entire roster.
body: Here's where the league sits at 7:15 Sunday morning. Jefferson’s Reserve leads Bourbon Lover 26.96 to 0.0, OBJAY leads Kraft for Cash 16.9 to 5.2, The Champ leads me 14.3 to 4.5, Dude, Your Getting a Dell leads Hold My DK 10.1 to 0.0, and Asian Jim leads Catfan94’s Farm Team 4.06 to 0.0 on the last points Daniel Jones will score for anybody for a while. LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and I Chase Brown Kids haven't started.

Good news first, for other people. The 49ers waived Brandin Cooks Saturday and plan to play Mike Evans Sunday night, so jmello16 gets his receiver back in the last game of the day. Baker Mayfield is expected to play at 1:00 with a custom orthotic, and jrsmith1391 has him at superflex next to Brock Purdy. That's two starting quarterbacks against an Asian Jim team running out Tyler Shough. Line's up to 31.0.

Now the holes. Dalton Kincaid is Doubtful and still in the OBJAY lineup at tight end. And ManicOrientals, who is a 31-point dog and has nothing to lose, picked up Dawson Knox at 6:03 this morning. Knox is the Bills tight end who plays if Kincaid doesn't. JAY2913 has Oronde Gadsden and Tyler Higbee on the bench and under six hours to use one of them. Brock Bowers and Ladd McConkey are both Questionable in the 4:25 and 4:05 windows, so Catfan94 and ManicOrientals find out about 90 minutes before kickoff, same as everybody.

And then there's me. I said Saturday I'd move Justin Fields in for Drake Maye. I went and looked. Justin Fields is Patrick Mahomes' backup. Jalon Daniels is fourth on the Tampa Bay depth chart. Shedeur Sanders is on taxi and Jalen Hurts is on IR. In a superflex league, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has zero quarterbacks who will start an NFL game this week. That's not a lineup mistake. That's a roster built by a guy with 12 first-round picks and no idea what to do with them. The Champ by 47.0. Pencil it in.

stories.title: The Colts cut Daniel Jones, and the quarterback who replaces him is sitting on the Kraft for Cash bench
stories.dek: Asian Jim loses its starting quarterback to a pink slip, BTaylor1 gets a free starter for the stretch run, and Baker Mayfield is trending toward playing.
body: One day after Daniel Jones scored 4.06 against Houston, Indianapolis released him. Shane Steichen announced it Friday and named Anthony Richardson Sr. the starter going forward, beginning with the Giants in Week 12. Jones goes on NFL waivers and becomes a free agent Monday afternoon if nobody claims him. His 4.06 for Asian Jim this week already counts. Every week after this, it's whatever team picks him up, if one does.

That leaves ManicOrientals with Tyler Shough and Kyler Murray, and Murray is Out again this week with a hamstring. Asian Jim was 5‑5 with three straight wins on Thursday morning. It's now a 30.5-point underdog to Catfan94’s Farm Team with its starting quarterback unemployed. In a superflex league, that's the whole ballgame for the next four weeks.

The winner is BTaylor1. Anthony Richardson Sr. has been sitting on the Kraft for Cash bench behind Bryce Young and Justin Herbert, and he's 24 with a starting job as of Friday. Kraft for Cash is 6‑4 and now has three starting quarterbacks for two spots. That's a trade chip with a waiting list, and I'd bet ManicOrientals is already typing.

Elsewhere: Baker Mayfield is Questionable but Todd Bowles says he's trending toward playing, which kills my $11 Jalon Daniels plan. Kenneth Walker III is Out and jrsmith1391 already has him on the bench. Dalton Kincaid is Doubtful and still in the OBJAY lineup. And Drake Maye is still in my quarterback slot on Saturday morning. He's out indefinitely with an ankle injury, New England is on bye, and none of that is the problem. The problem is the guy who sets the lineup. I'll fix it tonight. Justin Fields plays at 1:00.

stories.title: Four weeks left: Kraft for Cash is 6‑4, and The Champ, Jefferson’s Reserve and Asian Jim are all 5‑5
stories.dek: Six teams make it. The top three are close to locked. The tiebreaker is points for, and TJohn91 has the most of the 5‑5 teams by a lot.
body: LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix and Hold My DK are 9‑1. Catfan94’s Farm Team is 7‑3. Those three are at least two games clear of seventh place with four weeks to play, so the real fight is for spots four through six between Kraft for Cash at 6‑4 and three teams at 5‑5.

Points for is the tiebreaker. Among the 5‑5 teams: The Champ 1414.72, Jefferson’s Reserve 1253.50, Asian Jim 1191.98. TJohn91 is 161.22 points ahead of jmello16 and 222.74 ahead of ManicOrientals, which is almost two full weeks of scoring. If it's a three-way tie at the end, the two-time champ is in.

I Chase Brown Kids (1219.86) and OBJAY (1184.34) are 4‑6, one game back. Bourbon Lover and StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte are 3‑7 and need four straight wins and some help. Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10 and mathematically eliminated: seven teams already have five wins, and Br0phy can finish with four at best.

This week's games that matter: Jefferson’s Reserve is a 22.3-point favorite over Bourbon Lover. Kraft for Cash is a 17.0-point favorite over OBJAY now that Geno Smith is Questionable. Catfan94’s Farm Team is a 27.7-point favorite over Asian Jim, with Smith-Njigba on bye. And The Champ gets me, a team whose quarterback depends on Baker Mayfield's ankle, so pencil TJohn91 in for 6‑5.

stories.title: Week 10: Hold My DK beats me by 117.42, Asian Jim steals Monday night, and Dude, Your Getting a Dell is 0‑10
stories.dek: Two teams are 9‑1, four teams are fighting over three playoff spots, and I'm 3‑7 with no quarterback for Week 11.
body: Hold My DK 196.34, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte 78.92. That's a 117.42-point margin, the biggest of the week and the second-biggest of the season behind Catfan94's 127.22 in Week 5. Christian McCaffrey had 50.3, Patrick Mahomes 45.92, and Derrick Henry added 16.5 on Monday night with two touchdowns on 10 yards rushing. Chuba Hubbard scored 35.7 on the bench. TheMoneyTeam2302 is 9‑1 and has scored 1582.92 points.

The game of the week happened Monday. Kraft for Cash led Asian Jim 89.30 to 84.06 going into Chargers at Ravens, and BTaylor1 had Zay Flowers left against three for ManicOrientals. Flowers scored 9.9. Omarion Hampton ran for 105 yards and a touchdown for 19.0, Tre' Harris caught five for 86 (12.6) and Justice Hill added 7.8. Final: Asian Jim 123.46, Kraft for Cash 99.20. ManicOrientals pulled Ladd McConkey for Harris before kickoff, and that move is worth a win. Asian Jim has won three straight and is 5‑5.

LigmaBrocksAndLoveMyPenix beat Jefferson’s Reserve 232.54 to 134.62, the second-highest score in league history, and is 9‑1 with six straight wins. The Champ beat Dude, Your Getting a Dell 166.08 to 68.10; Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards and scored 12.3, and Br0phy is 0‑10. Catfan94’s Farm Team beat OBJAY 138.94 to 83.62, and I Chase Brown Kids beat Bourbon Lover 124.46 to 116.92 in the closest game of the week.

Bad beat: Jefferson’s Reserve scored 134.62, the fifth-highest score of the week, and lost by 97.92. Low score: Dude, Your Getting a Dell at 68.10. And for the record, I scored 78.92 and started AJ Barner at superflex while Dalton Schultz (8.1) and Samaje Perine (13.9) sat on my bench. Swap those two in and I score 93.12 and lose by 103.22 instead of 117.42. Still the worst week of anyone not named Br0phy.

Both teams fix a real hole.

Catfan94 has Josh Allen, Michael Penix Jr. and Jordan Love for two quarterback spots. I have Drake Maye out with a fractured fibula, Justin Fields backing up Mahomes, and a fourth-stringer. Parker Washington scored 27.2 in Week 10 and would be the third receiver on a 9‑1 team. I need a quarterback for 2027 more than I need a receiver for December.

Bourbon Lover is 3‑7 and down 26.96 before Sunday, so paknight12 sells two veterans. BTaylor1 is 6‑4 with three starters on bye. Contender buys now, rebuilder gets a taxi-squad running back and a young receiver back.

jmello16 has five quarterbacks and J.J. McCarthy scored 22.12 on his bench in Week 10. I have zero quarterbacks starting an NFL game this week, and Dalton Schultz keeps getting benched for worse tight ends on my roster anyway.
BTaylor1 trades the new Colts starter and his best running back for the quarterback the Colts just released, because 'he knows the playbook.' Nobody would do this.

ManicOrientals panics about quarterback and pays the best tight end and best receiver on the roster for a 38-year-old backup and a 33-year-old receiver. jmello16 accepts and still doesn't spend any FAAB.
I give up two taxi-squad pieces for a quarterback who doesn't have a team. 10‑28 all time is not an accident.

columns.title: Bill_Buttlicker built a superflex roster with no quarterbacks and 12 first-round picks. Pick one, son.
columns.dek: Richard "Dick" Gozinya says you don't get to cry about Drake Maye when you never bought a backup.
body: I want to be fair to the man who runs this site. Losing Drake Maye isn't a bad decision. That happens to every roster in football, and nobody gets to blame a manager for it. What he did after it is a different story.

Here's the quarterback room for StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte as of Sunday morning. Maye, Out. Justin Fields, Kansas City's backup. Jalon Daniels, Tampa Bay's fourth-stringer, and Baker Mayfield is expected to play. Shedeur Sanders on the taxi squad. Jalen Hurts on IR. In a league where you start two quarterbacks, that's zero. Zero. When I played, if you showed up to camp without a helmet, you sat. He showed up without two.

Meanwhile jmello16 has five quarterbacks, I Chase Brown Kids has six, and Kraft for Cash has three starters for two spots. Bill_Buttlicker owns 12 first-round picks over the next three drafts. He's 3‑7 and 10‑28 all time. You can't hoard draft capital forever and call it a plan. Go buy a quarterback. Use a pick. That's what they're for. Toughen up and spend.

columns.title: Daniel Jones scored 4.06 and lost his job. By my math, that's worth 4.06 jobs.
columns.dek: Ivana Humpalot ran the Friday transaction wire through her spreadsheet and is very confident in what came out.
body: Daniel Jones went 12 of 27 for 144 yards Thursday, scored 4.06 for Asian Jim, and was released Friday. That's 144 yards per release, which my model says is the league's most efficient release rate this season. Nobody else has been released at all, so he's also the leader by infinity.

Anthony Richardson Sr. is 24 and on the Kraft for Cash bench. Jones is 29. That's a five-year age gap, and in dynasty each year is worth roughly 1.0 years, so BTaylor1 gained five years of quarterback overnight without making a transaction. That's 0 FAAB dollars per year, tied with jmello16 for the best rate in the league.

OBJAY leads Kraft for Cash 16.9 to 5.2, an 11.7-point lead. I moved the line 1.5 points toward Kraft for Cash because Dalton Kincaid is Doubtful. 11.7 divided by 1.5 is 7.8, which means OBJAY needs Kincaid to be 7.8 times more doubtful before it's a toss-up. I don't know what that looks like, but I've charted it.

Finally, StrngeJhnsonHurtsmyBoutte has 0.0 points from the quarterback slot this week; the only points so far are Ashton Dulin's 4.5 at receiver. Projected quarterback points with the current lineup: 0.0. Projected with one click to Justin Fields: more than 0.0. That's an infinite percentage improvement, the second-largest in league history behind Jones' release rate.

columns.title: 5 Sunday morning moves from Holden McGroin, who drafts quarterbacks by jersey color
columns.dek: Kickoff is at 1:00. Holden McGroin has been up since 4:00 and his advice has gotten worse every hour.
body: 1. JAY2913, keep Dalton Kincaid in. Doubtful isn't No. It's Maybe with a frown. I once started a guy listed Out because 'Out' could mean 'out there, getting open.' He did not play. I lost by 40. I stand by the reasoning.
2. Bill_Buttlicker, Drake Maye is Out, so start Justin Fields. What do you mean he's the backup? Backups play all the time. Patrick Mahomes has to sneeze eventually. Ride the sneeze.
3. ManicOrientals, you picked up Dawson Knox, so start him. You have Trey McBride? Start both. Start three tight ends. The more tight ends you start, the tighter your lineup. That's just physics.

4. Br0phy, you're up 10.1 to 0.0. Ask the commissioners if you can end the game early. Catfan94 and TJohn91 will say no, but the mercy rule has to start somewhere, and it should start with the 0‑10 team.

5. jrsmith1391, Baker Mayfield is wearing new cleats. New cleats mean a new man. Double-start him. I don't know if Sleeper allows that. Try it anyway and report back. I'm told this is how innovation happens.
